sloka: तथा इति नृपतिः प्रीतः शिरसा प्रति गृह्य ताम् ।पात्रीम् देव अन्न संपूर्णाम् देव दत्ताम् हिरण्मयीम् ॥१-१६-२१॥
transliteration: tathā iti nṛpatiḥ prītaḥ śirasā prati gṛhya tām ।pātrīm deva anna saṁpūrṇām deva dattām hiraṇmayīm ॥1-16-21॥

translations.english: Dasaratha was pleased to receive respectfully the golden vessel filled with the payasam prepared and bestowed by devatas.
